half_life_manometer.name: Half-Life Manometer
half_life_manometer.description: Reads ΦΔE — the rate of becoming. A vortessence column beside a dial whose needle twitches toward 0.4. The cost of delta, given a needle.

halting_lantern.name: Halting Lantern
halting_lantern.description: A lamp wired to a computation proven unpredictable — it burns forever or goes dark, and you can only watch. Undecidability as furniture.

imitation_gate.name: Imitation Gate
imitation_gate.description: Two doors and a slit: which is human? It tests how long you bear not knowing — the imitation game as the closet rebuilt as apparatus.

morphogen_tide_pool.name: Morphogen Tide-Pool
morphogen_tide_pool.description: Turing's reaction-diffusion in a shallow pool with a λ dial; spots are born and stay alive at λ≈0.4. Morphogenesis = QFEP twice.
morphogen_tide_pool.qfep_connection: Spots caught mid-argument between two reagents, with the dial welded at λ = 0.4 — the one setting where the pattern neither freezes into order nor dissolves into noise. Turing's morphogenesis and the QFEP edge condition presented as a single bench: aliveness as a value of λ, not a substance.

apple_cell.name: Apple Cell
apple_cell.description: A battery fuelled only by difference — the tax on being other made into the current. The cost of delta, Turing's own. Handle with both hands.

vortessence_tap.name: Vortessence Tap
vortessence_tap.description: A tap into the shared field that binds all life across time. The needle was reading your node in a field of all becoming. The beyond.

universal_lathe.name: Universal Lathe
universal_lathe.description: A machine that becomes any machine its tape describes — itself included. The universal machine, the bench every instrument sits on.

lambda_organ.name: Lambda Organ
lambda_organ.description: One master slider runs order (0) to noise (1); the sample crystallises, dissolves, or — at λ≈0.4 — lives. The entropy drive given a hand.

delta_forge.name: Delta Forge
delta_forge.description: An anvil that strikes two same tokens until one is other than the other. The blow is the cost; the sparks are what difference throws off.

entropy_bellows.name: Entropy Bellows
entropy_bellows.description: A bellows pumping disorder (λE) into an ordered lattice until form loosens — weighted entropy made into breath.

order_loom.name: Order Loom
order_loom.description: A loom weaving noise back into pattern — the F term, order as labour against entropy, something done not given.

becoming_hourglass.name: Becoming Hourglass
becoming_hourglass.description: Sand that transmutes mid-fall, amber above and green below — the half-life given a body, every grain paying at the waist.

observer_cage.name: Observer Cage
observer_cage.description: A booth whose external gauge moves the moment you enter. To measure a becoming is to be a force inside it.

incompleteness_scale.name: Incompleteness Scale
incompleteness_scale.description: A balance that cannot weigh itself, tilting forever — Gödel as furniture, the limit built into the shape of the thing.
incompleteness_scale.qfep_connection: A balance that cannot weigh itself, tilting forever — Gödel as furniture. In the grammar chapter it stands as the fine print on the whole enterprise: every rewriting system rich enough to describe growth is too rich to certify its own limits. The forest the sentence becomes contains questions the sentence cannot answer.

enigma_rotor_stack.name: Enigma Rotor Stack
enigma_rotor_stack.description: Toothed rotors and a lampboard that surface signal from noise — Turing's faith that structure hides inside the random.

strange_loop_stair.name: Strange Loop Stair
strange_loop_stair.description: A staircase that climbs all the way around back to itself — self-reference made walkable, the loop that holds computation together.

phase_chamber_bell.name: Phase Chamber Bell
phase_chamber_bell.description: A bell jar over a specimen oscillating F↔E with a phase needle. Life is the swing between the poles, not either pole.

catalyst_altar.name: Catalyst Altar
catalyst_altar.description: A pedestal holding the catalyst's three modes — cube, wedge, off — on a ring. The power to phase-shift foe to friend, solid to walkable.

cost_ledger.name: Cost Ledger
cost_ledger.description: An abacus tallying what difference has cost, bead by bead — the cost of delta refused the comfort of staying abstract.

vortigaunt_lattice_harp.name: Vortigaunt Lattice Harp
vortigaunt_lattice_harp.description: Pluck one light-string and all answer, because they are not separate — a body for the truth that the living field is one.

half_life_clock.name: Half-Life Clock
half_life_clock.description: Hands that tell not the time but the remaining sameness — ALL, HALF, NONE — and move only one way. The title made literal.

delta_butterfly.name: Delta Butterfly
delta_butterfly.description: Two trajectories begin a hair apart and end in different worlds — sensitive dependence, where the smallest Δ is amplified until it decides everything. The bridge between difference and cost.

time_ratchet.name: Time Ratchet
time_ratchet.description: A toothed wheel and pawl that turn one way only — the second law as a mechanism. Why the half-life runs forward and the cost of delta is never refunded.

coupling_resonator.name: Coupling Resonator
coupling_resonator.description: Two manometers joined by a glowing rod; move one needle and the other answers. Two becomings entangled — the smallest unit of relation.
